error.title: Something needs your attention
error.VIRTUALIZATION_DISABLED_IN_FIRMWARE: Hardware virtualization is disabled. Enable Intel VT-x or AMD-V in your BIOS/UEFI settings (usually under Advanced or CPU), then start Solon again.
error.UNSUPPORTED_WINDOWS_EDITION: Solon requires Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise or Education. Windows Home does not include the components Solon needs.
error.WINDOWS_FEATURE_MISSING: A Windows component is missing. Reinstall Solon to enable it; a restart may be required.
error.WINDOWS_FEATURE_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY: Your organization restricts enabling Windows components. Ask your administrator to enable Hyper-V and Virtual Machine Platform.
error.HYPERVISOR_NOT_RUNNING: The Windows virtualization engine is not running. Common causes: an older VirtualBox/VMware, virtualization disabled at boot, or running inside another virtual machine.
error.HOST_COMPUTE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A Windows service Solon depends on (Host Compute Service) is stopped or missing. Restart Windows; if it persists, reinstall Solon.
error.BLOCKED_BY_SECURITY_SOFTWARE: A security product is blocking Solon. Add the Solon folder to its exclusions.
error.INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES: Solon does not have the rights it needs. Reinstalling Solon repairs the background service.
error.VM_CONFIGURATION_REJECTED: Windows rejected the engine configuration. Please report this with the log file.
error.VM_BOOT_TIMEOUT: The engine did not start in time.
error.AGENT_UNREACHABLE: The engine started but is not responding.
error.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Docker did not become ready in time.
error.IMAGE_CORRUPTED: The container engine files are missing or corrupted. Reinstall Solon.
error.DATA_DISK_ERROR: The storage disk could not be created or opened.
error.HCS_ERROR: The virtualization layer returned an error.
